title: FulfillmentOrderItemTax - Data API
description: Represents the tax on a FulfillmentOrderLineItem or FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustment. Corresponds to an OrderItemTaxLineItemSummary. This object is available in API version 48.0 and later.

Amount.description: Amount of tax represented by the FulfillmentOrderItemTax.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
CurrencyIsoCode.description: ISO code for the currency of the FulfillmentOrderLineItem to which the tax applies. The default value is USD. Possible values are: DKK—Danish Krone EUR—Euro GBP—British Pound USD—U.S. Dollar This field is available in API version 49.0 and later.

FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustId.description: If this object represents tax on an adjustment, this value is the ID of the FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustment to which the tax applies. If this value is null, the adjustment applies to a FulfillmentOrderLineItem.

FulfillmentOrderItemTaxNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

FulfillmentOrderLineItemId.description: If this object represents tax on a FulfillmentOrderLineItem, this value is the ID of that FulfillmentOrderLineItem. If this object represents tax on an adjustment, this value is the ID of the FulfillmentOrderLineItem to which the adjustment applies.

OrderItemTaxLineItemSummaryId.description: ID of the OrderItemTaxLineItemSummary associated with the OrderItemSummary that corresponds to the FulfillmentOrderLineItem to which the tax applies.

Rate.description: Tax rate used to calculate the Amount.

TaxEffectiveDate.description: Date on which the Amount was calculated. Important due to tax rate changes over time.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: Indicates whether the Amount is actual or estimated. Possible values are: Actual Estimated

special_access_rules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

OrderItemTaxLineItemSummaryId.field_label: Order Product Tax Line Item Summary ID
